summary: Bulk actions (iteration 17) verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering POST /api/dashboard/leads/bulk (status, delete, tag+filter, untag, assign valid, assign invalid 404, assign null unassign, auth, empty-ids rejection) and POST /api/dashboard/customers/bulk (delete removes customers + sessions + designs; auth required). GET /api/dashboard/leads returns the tags list and the ?tag= filter correctly narrows results. Frontend (desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x844): admin login works, leads screen renders 17 rows, leads-select-all enables bulk-bar with correct bulk-count, bulk-action-status/assign/tag each open their panels (bulk-panel-*), bulk-tag-input + Add/Remove tag chips render, bulk-clear hides the bar, and tapping a row (not the checkbox) navigates to /admin/leads/{id}. Customers screen UI shares the same BulkBar component and testIDs (customer-select-<id>, customers-select-all, bulk-action-export, bulk-action-delete) — one Cloudflare 502 during navigation prevented live customers UI click-through this run (transient infra), but backend bulk-delete flow is fully proven. No destructive bulk mutations were performed against real Gado data.
action_items: No code changes required. Optionally add testID on the Pressable row inside admin/customers.tsx (currently customer-row-<id> is on the outer View, not Pressable, but there is no row-tap handler there, so this is fine).
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py bulk_leads uses tenancy-scoped collection (_db.quotes bound via tenancy to admin tenant); other-business leads cannot be affected because the admin's tenant_id scopes _db queries via the shared tenancy wrapper.
LeadBulkPanel: tag input is cleared on each submit via onTag but after submit the text state isn't reset — minor UX nit; main agent may clear state after onTag fires.
bulk.tsx useSelection: ids are filtered by visibleIds so hidden-but-selected items drop out — correct for pagination/filter changes.
customers bulk only supports action=delete per Literal — correct per spec.
Status change system note text uses .title() which produces 'Contacted', 'Quoted' etc — matches the backend test assertion and UI copy.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create 3 TEST_ leads (POST /api/quotes) and 2 TEST_ customers (POST /api/customers/register) and clean them up via the same bulk-delete endpoints at teardown. No real Gado data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk endpoints and UI are stable. If re-running, set EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var before pytest. Customers page navigation briefly hit a Cloudflare 502 during this run; re-run the mobile viewport customers flow if deeper UI validation is needed.
